map.批量生成 1024-65535 随机 TCP/UDP 端口，可自动避开常用保留端: Batch-generate random TCP/UDP ports from 1024–65535, optionally avoiding common reserved ports, with a quick-reference table of common ports.
map.：端口号 0–65535，分公认端口（0–1023）、注册端口（1024–491: : Port numbers range 0–65535, divided into well-known ports (0–1023), registered ports (1024–49151), and dynamic ports (49152–65535).

map.在 1024–65535 范围内生成随机端口号，不检测端口是否被占用。: Generate random port numbers in the 1024–65535 range; the tool does not check whether a port is in use.
map.为本地服务挑一个高位端口（本工具取值 1024–65535，不保证未被占用）。: Pick a high port for a local service (this tool samples 1024–65535 and does not guarantee the port is free).
map.不一定。本工具在 1024–65535 范围内随机取值（含注册端口段 1024–: Not necessarily. This tool picks random values from 1024–65535 (including the registered range 1024–49151) and cannot know in real time which ports are occupied on your machine—browsers are also restricted from scanning local ports for security. Before use, confirm with netstat/lsof, or let the program bind port 0 and let the OS assign one. If you only want the dynamic range, filter results above 49152 yourself.
map.生成个数取输入值并保证在 1 到 20 之间。循环直到凑够数量或尝试次数达到 1: The count is taken from the input and clamped to 1–20. It loops until enough ports are collected or 1000 attempts are reached: each attempt fills an unsigned 32-bit integer with cryptographically secure randomness, and the port = 1024 + random mod (65535 − 1024 + 1), i.e. in the range 1024–65535; when "avoid common reserved ports" is on and the port hits the reserved table it is skipped; duplicates of already generated ports are skipped. Finally it lists each port with its protocol and notes the count and whether common reserved ports were avoided; the tool does not check whether a port is actually in use
